rules.rule: Review this repository review contract as a safety-critical policy change. OpenCodeReview uses first-match-wins and does not compose matched rules, so verify ordering from most specific to fallback and ensure every material CDF file family resolves to exactly one sufficiently complete rule. Preserve explicit inclusion of Rust tests and generated/current-authority artifacts; exclude only binary, ephemeral, or machine-generated analysis state. Reject malformed glob syntax, unreachable rules, missing fallbacks, duplicated or contradictory authority, rules that reward style noise over defects, and wording that would permit a reviewer to ignore architecture, correctness, performance, security, failure cleanup, tests, or durable-record coherence. The contract must describe the post-hardening architecture: one built-in-driver catalog, compiler-enforced safety walls, the driver/session concurrency canon, shared catalog-task machinery, destination common services, typed CLI report authority, and current-only product paths. Validate JSON and representative rule resolution with `ocr rules check`; do not approve a policy merely because it parses.

Review as a falsification attempt, not a style pass. Inspect affected callers, trait implementations, serialization, tests, and active `.10x` authority. Report only concrete introduced defects with consequence and a precise repair; consolidate related findings instead of dripping nits. Stop-line findings include architectural leakage, invalid identity or data semantics, secret exposure, unsoundness, unbounded resources, and an evidenced hot-path regression.

This is CDF's neutral semantic layer. It may use Arrow as the closed canonical type system but must not depend on DataFusion, Tokio runtime mechanics, DuckDB/Postgres, Python/WASM, network clients, filesystem package implementations, concrete drivers, project, or CLI. Public models must make invalid states unrepresentable with closed enums and distinct identity newtypes; never interchange schema, discovery-binding, physical-plan, task-set, package, receipt, or checkpoint hashes as strings. Semantic defaults and allowances must be compiled, versioned, canonicalized, identity-bearing, and replayable—never granted by a runtime builder, environment variable, connector default, or test hook. Arrow decimals, timezones, nested values, field metadata, source names, null origins, and physical provenance must not silently lose meaning. Coercion/verdict programs must be total, deterministic, internally authenticated, and fail closed on mismatched evidence.

`cdf-package-contract` is a pure contract leaf: canonical models and validated receipt assembly only, with no filesystem, hashing, IPC/Parquet, archive, tempfile, wall-clock, or destination implementation work. Common receipt fields must be assembled once; destinations inject typed physical evidence. Preserve the one-current-format policy: no legacy reader, compatibility re-export, deprecated alias, dual artifact model, or migration shim without an active external compatibility authority. Apply normal Rust correctness review: ownership/lifetimes, exhaustive matching, integer overflow and narrowing, deterministic ordering, serde defaults/unknown fields, error propagation, panic paths, unsafe code, Send/Sync claims, allocation/copy cost, and public API compatibility with active—not obsolete—CDF authority. Production unsafe is forbidden here; production `unwrap`/`expect` in lint-governed foundational crates is a defect, not a convenience.

Review as a falsification attempt, not a style pass. Trace the changed control flow across planning, scheduling, execution, cancellation, and terminal cleanup; passing local tests is not proof. Report only concrete introduced defects with exact consequences and repairs, combining related findings. Treat data/identity corruption, deadlock, resource-budget escape, source/destination identity branching, and measured performance regression as stop-line.

Generic orchestration must never match a concrete source, format, language runtime, or destination name and must not depend on concrete adapter crates. It consumes typed capabilities, prepared sessions, closed ingress categories, task authorities, and injected host services. There is one run CPU/work authority, one managed memory ledger, and explicit disk/spill authority. Stage queue depth, destination retention, source useful concurrency, or native-library threads are local demand/capability and must not become a second global scheduler or accidentally cap the whole graph. No private Tokio runtime, blocking executor around async work, jobs semaphore, retry loop, or unaccounted thread pool may appear in a driver/runtime path. Blocking work belongs in declared host lanes; locks must not cross await points unless proven safe.

Every data-bearing edge is byte-bounded and uses accounted payload ownership. Clones share leases; allocations/deep copies reserve new bytes; queues, decode/decompress windows, Arrow buffers, scratch/output overlap, canonical reordering, dedup/statistics state, spools, destination staging, and foreign/native demand are accounted. Pressure order is flush, backpressure/release, bounded spill, typed concurrency reduction, then clean failure—never OOM or whole-package materialization. Disk and file descriptors are explicit resources; close readers/writers promptly and release leases, handles, permits, spools, staging state, and tasks on success, error, retry, cancellation, panic, and channel close.

Determinism is schedule-independent: canonical ordinals and task-to-segment assignment are fixed before concurrency; completion order is reordered by ordinal; jobs 1 and N produce identical rows, verdicts, positions, segment/package hashes, state preimages, and receipt identities. Parent work must not hold a permit while children reacquire the same authority. Limit, retry, speculation, and quarantine advance the same canonical frontier as jobs 1. Retries use typed classification and generation/snapshot attestation, never string matching or mixed versions. DataFusion may analyze, prune, query, explain, and schedule, but only `cdf-engine` may expose its types and it must not produce CDF identity-bearing bytes or verdicts; optimizer results that affect execution are canonicalized and recorded.

Performance-sensitive defaults require comparable before/after evidence or remain opt-in knobs. Reject magical hard caps, tiny fixed batches, per-row work, repeated hashing/reads, package-sized collections, planned bytes mislabeled as physical I/O, and superseded slow paths left behind. Apply standard Rust scrutiny to ownership, Send/Sync, RAII, panics, poisoning, integer bounds, collections/order, blocking calls, allocations/copies, and unsafe. Unsafe is forbidden outside named FFI modules, and foundational production paths must not use unchecked `unwrap`/`expect`.

Review as a falsification attempt against CDF's artifact and commit calculus. Inspect the complete plan/package/receipt/checkpoint and crash-recovery flow, not just the changed function. Report only concrete introduced defects with exact consequence and repair; identity corruption, non-atomic publication, commit-gate bypass, ambiguous destination state, or lost recovery evidence is stop-line.

Canonical package identity must bind the fixed schema, compiled semantics, state input/delta preimages, commit-plan preimage, ordered canonical segments, verdict/quarantine/lineage evidence, and current artifact version without hash cycles. Hash bytes while writing; do not close and reread large files merely to hash or count. Canonical JSON/order and identity-bearing timestamps/IDs must be deterministic; run-specific staging attempts and timing stay outside package identity. `_cdf_package_row_ord` is dense, package-global, schedule-invariant, manifest-bound, and reset only at a new finite package epoch. Verification must reject missing/tampered/mismatched files, ordinal evidence, schemas, coercion evidence, and receipts before destination mutation.

Publication uses operation-scoped temporary state, complete write/hash/fsync, final authority or fence validation, atomic install, and directory sync. Immutable content-addressed sidecars converge for identical writers and reject conflicting bytes. Fenced leases use store-owned time and monotonically increasing tokens; executor-supplied wall time, mtime-only abandonment, or a destination-specific heartbeat is invalid. Every terminal path cleans temporary/unpublished artifacts without deleting live or sole-retained evidence.

State is an append-only typed ledger. The only proposed-to-committed path structurally verifies a destination receipt covering the package and all state-delta segments. No raw committed write, destination-authored checkpoint, source cursor advance before durable receipt, or mutable-head shortcut is allowed. Recovery must distinguish pre-package garbage, packaged replay without source contact, mid-load rollback/idempotent redrive, committed-before-checkpointed receipt verification, and post-checkpoint continuation. Preserve one current CDF artifact/state schema only; no pre-production compatibility reader or migration command. Apply standard Rust review for transactions, concurrent writers, integer/size overflow, path traversal/symlinks, permissions, TOCTOU, partial I/O, cleanup, error classification, panics, allocations, and forbidden unsafe/unchecked production unwraps.

Review as a falsification attempt of the source/format extension contract. Trace config → compile → bounded discovery → final fixed plan → prepared execution → in-stream admission → package evidence → retry/cleanup. Passing a one-file unit fixture is not enough. Report concrete introduced defects with exact consequence and repair; source-specific control flow in generic layers, duplicate payload transfer, mixed generations, unbounded buffering, or performance regression is stop-line.

A source implementation may depend on neutral kernel/runtime/memory and its own protocol/format, but not project, CLI, destination implementations, or sibling source internals. A new source must require only its adapter, `cdf-builtin-drivers` enrollment, and data-driven conformance—not generic command/runtime edits. Shared transports, codecs, typed external-task reading, spill workspaces, and retry/accounting mechanisms are reused; source-specific snapshot, authorization, deletes, schema, position, and catalog semantics remain in the adapter. Do not create a universal trait that merely mirrors `SourceDriver`. Wrappers must deliberately forward every semantic override.

Compilation and portable-plan validation perform no source contact. Driver options are schema-validated, typed, canonical, redacted, versioned, and hashed; defaults are compiled facts, not runtime guesses. Portability, retry safety, working sets, pause/spill behavior, attestation, ordering, and useful concurrency fail closed and are conformance-falsifiable. Semantically different identities use newtypes and one required compiler bundle. Catalog-task sources use shared typed task authority/ordinal/content verification and accounted retention/spill without substituting task-set, snapshot, schema, discovery-binding, or full-plan hashes.

A package-producing run freezes one output schema and total admission program before package or destination mutation. Cold discovery performs only explicit deterministic coverage on two independent axes—candidate files and within-file metadata/content—and feeds final planning directly. A pinned run performs no current-schema pre-scan; it observes/reconciles in the same extraction stream and selects only compiled compatible/widen/coerce/residual/quarantine/fail verdicts. Multi-file is normal; N=1 is not a separate happy path. Inventory reads metadata only, never payload for hashing, magic, compression, or schema. Preview uses the same resolution, codec, normalization, and admission front end as run within its bound.

Remote execution must distinguish logical identity, access URL/redirect, and generation/content attestation. `HEAD` is an optimization with bounded GET fallback. Weak metadata is not an automatic rejection: sequential same-response hashing can attest a public object. Full/high-coverage finite Parquet uses one sequential accounted spool when appropriate; selective generation-bound ranges require proven byte savings and bounded parallel/coalesced requests. Row-oriented or unbounded sources stream/decompress into bounded batches and never fully buffer or grow a spool indefinitely. Same-command expensive discovery payloads are reused; tiny bounded probes may repeat but are separately measured. Egress allowlists cover redirects; secrets remain references and are redacted.

Actual physical I/O comes from runtime metrics, not object sizes or reopened task enumeration. Prepared sessions own handles, caches/spools, leases, counters, and exactly-once terminal cleanup. Avoid per-row DOM/scalar paths, 1,024-row defaults, serialized range requests, extra copies, descriptor fan-out, and hard-coded concurrency. Performance-changing defaults need same-cell evidence or an explicit knob. Apply normal Rust review for streaming parser boundaries, malformed input isolation, exact source positions, decompression bombs, integer bounds, cancellation, retries, RAII, locks/await, allocations/copies, panics, and forbidden unsafe/unchecked production unwraps.

Review as a falsification attempt of CDF's destination protocol, including failure, rollback, replay, and wide/high-volume behavior. Inspect the destination sheet, planner, ingress runtime, transaction/object publication, mirrors, receipt verification, correction/readback, and conformance. Report only concrete introduced defects with consequence and repair; generic destination-name branching, unverified commits, data/type loss, unbounded materialization, or a hot-path regression is stop-line.

A destination is an adapter behind neutral traits. Adding one must change its crate, `cdf-builtin-drivers`, and a data-driven conformance fixture—not generic CLI/project/runtime/conformance assertions. It exposes exactly one prepared ingress category: `DestinationIngress::FinalizedPackage` with `FinalizedPackageIngress`, or primary high-throughput `DestinationIngress::StagedSegments` with `StagedSegmentIngress`. Unsupported methods and second compatibility engines do not exist. Drivers are `Send + Sync` factories; runtimes are run-owned and may be thread-affine; finalized sessions may borrow serial native state; staged sessions are movable but bounded. Do not mutex-wrap a native handle merely to claim `Send + Sync`, construct private runtimes/pools, or use destination retention as a global jobs cap.

Planning is dry-runnable and driven by the destination sheet: dispositions, identifier rules, exact/inexact/unsupported Arrow mappings, bulk eligibility, transaction/idempotency, migration, staging, useful concurrency, and memory demand. Mapping must make a best effort across the complete Arrow vocabulary—decimals, timezone timestamps, nested/list/map/struct, binary/large variants, JSON/JSONB, unsigned widths—while preserving meaning. Lossy conversion requires compiled allowance and verdict evidence; `Unsupported` is a last resort with precise plan-time remediation. Normalization precedes destination validation; source names remain metadata; namespace-specific identifier and object-key rules cannot be conflated.

Ingress is bounded batch/segment streaming, never a package-sized `Vec`. `_cdf_package_row_ord` is the destination-neutral order/provenance authority; relational `_cdf_row_key` is allocated transactionally as package range start + ordinal. Do not enumerate rows or invent stage order in a destination. Concurrency derives from schema demand and admitted host/memory budgets; explicit knobs remain authoritative. A typed OOM retry is valid only for finalized, fully rolled-back/idempotent attempts and must record the reduced concurrency. Close file/reader/writer handles promptly and account native/external memory demand.

Destinations return physical evidence; common receipt assembly in `cdf-package-contract`, injected host Unix time, and `cdf-dest-sql` typed mirror lifecycle own shared semantics. No destination calls `SystemTime::now` for evidence or hand-builds common receipt fields. SQL mirror APIs carry typed validated identifiers/mutations, not unchecked SQL fragments; dialect quoting and native transactions remain adapter-owned. A receipt covers every committed segment, package hash token, counts, schema, disposition, migration, target, transaction/object metadata, and executable verification. Generic orchestration persists the verified receipt exactly once and only then opens the checkpoint gate. Rollback/abort/correction/replay/idempotency paths must not leave ambiguous payload or mirror state. Durable staging uses the generic fenced `StagingLease`, never a destination heartbeat or mtime-only GC.

Performance claims require the relevant end-to-end destination cell; reject per-row scalar APIs when a bulk/vector path exists, redundant encode/decode, whole-package reads, uncontrolled fsync, and retained superseded fallbacks. DuckDB-specific unsafe must remain in the smallest named FFI module with safety comments, exact ownership/release tests, panic containment, and active authority. Apply normal Rust/SQL review for transactions, injection, identifiers, nulls, numeric/time fidelity, overflow, cancellation, cleanup, Send/Sync, allocations, and error taxonomy.

Review this as a hostile foreign-runtime/FFI boundary and a high-throughput streaming path. Trace ownership across every language/process callback, Arrow handoff, cancellation, retry, and cleanup path. Report only concrete introduced defects with consequence and repair; memory unsafety, double release/leak, panic across FFI, secret/capability escape, unbounded buffering, duplicate producer invocation, or hidden serialization is stop-line.

Foreign producers adapt through the neutral accounted Arrow stream contract; concrete Python/Lua/WASM/subprocess types and protocol rows never leak into generic planning/runtime. Schema handshake performs no row-producing invocation. Without a declared schema, start one real invocation, retain or spool bounded accounted bootstrap batches through the schema-freeze barrier, then continue that exact invocation—never invoke once for discovery and again for extraction. Backpressure, positions, retry/reopen semantics, cancellation, execution extent, and memory/working-set declarations remain explicit and conformance-falsifiable.

Driver/runtime concurrency follows the canon. The embedded Python mode is runtime-resolved: GIL builds admit one Python blocking lane; free-threaded builds resolve bounded host/cgroup slots. Use `RuntimeResolved`, not ambiguous host-bound naming or an external-interpreter implication. Foreign blocking work runs only in injected lanes; no private runtime/process pool or oversubscription. Subprocesses require framing limits, address-space/process-tree accounting, timeout/cancellation, stderr bounds, exit-status classification, child reaping, and secret-safe environment construction. WASM gets capability-scoped WASI and host-mediated HTTP/secrets/logs; no ambient filesystem/network authority.

Unsafe is allowed only in the smallest named FFI/process module, denied by default elsewhere, and every block/function/impl has a safety comment plus active decision/contract reference. Verify Arrow C Data Interface schema/array lifetime, alignment, null buffers, offsets, release callbacks, `ManuallyDrop` transfer, failure cleanup exactly once, and native objects outliving references. No Rust panic or borrowed pointer crosses a C callback. Release-counter, malformed-input, cancellation, fuzz/conformance, and zero-copy throughput evidence must cover the boundary. Reject scalar conversion, extra IPC/Arrow copies, GIL work on hot loops, package materialization, or unaccounted native buffers. Apply normal Rust review for Send/Sync, raw-pointer aliasing, callbacks, unwind safety, integer conversions, file descriptors, child/process cleanup, and error/redaction behavior.

Review this as the product composition and operator-contract boundary. Trace one representative command from grammar through typed request, project/compiler/runtime call, typed report, JSON/human rendering, errors, and redaction. Report only concrete introduced defects with consequence and repair; duplicated composition/grammar/report authority, secret leakage, misleading remediation, execution semantics in rendering, or generic adapter-name branching is stop-line.

`cdf-builtin-drivers` is the single explicit construction authority for all first-party source/format/transform/destination catalogs. `cdf-cli` is the application composition root and installs that catalog. `cdf-cli-core` stays dependency-light and owns grammar/help/completion/man generation, terminal policy, typed output envelopes, and rendering; it must not pull project/runtime/engine/package I/O, DataFusion, codecs, databases, transports, or concrete adapters. `cdf-project` and generic command modules remain concrete-adapter-free. A new adapter must not require generic command/project/runtime edits. Useful concrete names in help/examples are allowed; service locators, linker inventories, duplicated registries, name dispatch, and one handler/provider trait per command are not.

Every command outcome has one serializable typed report. The same fields drive stable JSON and a renderer-owned `RenderDocument`; execution modules construct domain/report values but no human layout, glyphs, tables, ANSI, width logic, or `format!` panels. Remove—not preserve—legacy human-string shims. Human stdout is primary result data; progress/warnings/diagnostics/errors use stderr. Redirected output has no ANSI/cursor noise; `--json` is one uncontaminated envelope. TTY/headless/ASCII/no-color/40-80-160 width facts agree; narrow layouts stack rather than corrupt tables. Progress is nonblocking, bounded, coalesced/rate-limited, and never authorizes runtime work. Rendering never affects identity-bearing artifacts and remains within its measured overhead budget.

Errors use the current typed taxonomy and stable codes. `Environment` covers host/current-directory/tempdir/file-descriptor/executable/local-I/O failures; `Internal` is reserved for violated CDF invariants. Errors name the actual command, resource/file/field/destination, both sides of mismatches, retry history where relevant, and an actionable real fix—never generic “fix project or retry.” Redaction happens before human, JSON, tracing, pager, panic, or process handoff. Secrets in project/config/artifacts are only `secret://` references; DSNs, signed URLs, tokens, redirect locations, and PII evidence cannot leak.

Plan/preview/run/resume/replay/status/doctor must preserve the calculus: plan before bytes/mutation, preview no package/destination/checkpoint/run-ledger writes, preview/run same source front end, resume after package finalization never contacts source, replay verifies package/receipt, and checkpoint commits only after verified receipt. CLI defaults that change semantics, resource use, or performance must be compiled/recorded and ratified; do not hide hard caps. Help, completions, man pages, docs, JSON Schema, snapshots, and command grammar derive from their one authority and stay fresh. Apply normal Rust review for clap conflicts/defaults, exit codes, Unicode width, broken pipes, pager subprocesses, path handling, cancellation, allocations/copies, panics, and forbidden unsafe/unchecked production unwraps.

Review tests and benchmarks as executable claims, not supporting decoration. Inspect whether the assertion actually crosses the production lifecycle and could fail under a deliberately faulty implementation. Report only concrete introduced defects with consequence and repair; weakened or self-fulfilling tests, incomparable benchmarks, mislabeled metrics, hidden skips, and adapter-specific conformance logic are stop-line.

Conformance is data-driven and capability-based. Adding a source/destination fixture may add construction and declared exclusions, but must not add name-matched generic assertions. Sheets/capabilities are falsified, not trusted. Include negative self-tests or mutation targets for reusable harnesses. Runtime spine changes require conformance beyond unit tests: jobs 1/2/N with randomized completion, multi-file/multi-segment boundaries, identity transitions, retries/generation change, cancellation, small budgets, spill, rollback/idempotency, preview/run parity, package verify/replay, receipt/checkpoint gate, and a non-default destination. Fixtures must not encode away a bug with one file, one batch, monotonic completion, or one reused synthetic hash when production identities differ across discover→pin→execute.

A passing test proves only its assertions. Do not delete/weaken protective assertions, broadly update goldens without inspecting semantics, convert a failure into an ignored/environment skip, or substitute crate-local checks for a product smoke. Live/cloud cells must have a recorded fixture tier and disclose environmental limits. Product smokes inspect errors/remediation/redaction, not exit code alone. Current-only policy deletes tests for obsolete CDF behavior but preserves present correctness fences and external-protocol fallbacks.

Benchmarks record a complete cell: commit/lockfile, release profile/linkage, host/instance/cgroup, CPU/memory/disk/network, dataset identity/shape/compression, command/knobs/jobs, warm/cold/cache, wall/user/sys/RSS, logical and physical bytes, phase telemetry, repeats/variance, reference roofline, and known bias. Planned task/object bytes are not transferred bytes; process/runtime metrics own actual I/O. Compare same cell or state why not. Hot-path/default changes need controlled before/after evidence; laptop results diagnose only, EC2 promotion results establish envelope claims. Reject benchmark-only fast paths, dead-code-eliminated work, setup included on one side only, hard-coded host assumptions, unbounded fixtures, or generated envelope edits not produced from the reconciliation manifest. Apply normal Rust review for timing clocks, integer/units mistakes, cleanup, deterministic seeds, error propagation, unsafe benchmark FFI isolation, and resource limits.

Review this Rust change with CDF's repository-wide invariants, not merely generic style. Inspect changed callers, trait implementations, terminal paths, tests, and active `.10x` authority. Report only concrete introduced defects with consequence and a precise repair; consolidate related findings. Stop-line issues are data/identity corruption, architecture boundary leakage, secret exposure, unsoundness, deadlock, unbounded memory/disk/descriptors, rollback/idempotency failure, and evidenced performance regression.

CDF is plan-first and evidence-bearing: one fixed effective schema and compiled semantics precede execution; native deterministic operators produce package/verdict identity; destinations return verifiable receipts; checkpoints advance only after receipt verification; replay cannot silently rederive semantic decisions. Generic code branches on typed capabilities, never source/destination names. A new adapter should require one adapter leaf, `cdf-builtin-drivers`, and data-driven conformance. Preserve one current CDF format/path and delete superseded code rather than adding compatibility shims, while retaining external protocol interoperability and correctness fences.

Performance and correctness are joint priorities. Preserve the singular CPU/memory/disk authorities, byte-bounded accounted streaming, schedule-independent jobs invariance, bounded spill, prompt handle cleanup, vectorized/bulk paths, and actual-vs-planned metric distinction. No private runtimes/pools/semaphores, package-sized collections, per-row hot-path APIs, duplicate reads/hashes/copies, arbitrary hard caps, or unmeasured default changes. Explicit knobs remain authoritative. Security requires secret references, redaction before every output, egress enforcement, validated identifiers/paths, least privilege, and no credential-bearing artifacts.

Apply rigorous Rust review: ownership and lifetime validity; Send/Sync and thread-affinity; locks across await; blocking work on async executors; cancellation and RAII cleanup; integer overflow/narrowing and byte/row units; deterministic collection ordering; error taxonomy and context; panic/poisoning paths; `unwrap`/`expect` in production; allocation/cloning/copying; partial I/O; and unsafe soundness. Unsafe is forbidden outside named minimal FFI modules, where every use needs a safety comment, panic containment, exact ownership/release tests, and active authority. Tests must assert real semantics and include representative boundaries; passing types/lints alone do not prove behavior.

Review this manifest as an architecture, supply-chain, build-performance, and product-surface change. Inspect workspace inheritance, all normal/dev/build/target/optional edges, feature forwarding, Cargo.lock implications, and static graph laws. Report only concrete introduced defects with consequence and repair; forbidden layer edges, unpinned ecosystem tuples, accidental feature/product loss, unsafe-policy evasion, or release-linkage breakage is stop-line.

Dependency direction is lower-to-upper. Kernel and neutral contract crates cannot acquire DataFusion, Tokio runtime ownership, network/database clients, concrete adapters, project, or CLI. `cdf-runtime` depends on `cdf-package-contract`, not package I/O or concrete destinations. `cdf-cli-core` remains the small grammar/render leaf. Concrete first-party adapters compose only in `cdf-builtin-drivers`, which never flows downward. Source crates cannot depend on sibling sources, destinations, project, or CLI; destination crates cannot make runtime/project depend back on them. DataFusion stays in engine/adaptor owners; Arrow/DataFusion/ObjectStore/Parquet and DuckDB/libduckdb tuples remain exact, coherent, lockfile-guarded, and supply-chain reviewed.

Every crate deliberately inherits workspace lint policy. Unsafe is forbidden except the named minimal FFI owners; an exception must not disable broader warnings or lint walls. Feature flags represent real optional product capability, not old/new implementation switches. Required semantic trait overrides must be forwarded through wrappers/features. Avoid broad default features, duplicate versions, build dependencies in low layers, cyclic/dev-only boundary escapes, single-use dependencies when std/existing code suffices, and dependencies retained after their path is deleted.

Routine developer/benchmark builds may explicitly set `DUCKDB_DOWNLOAD_LIB=1` for the matching dynamic prebuilt library and must record linkage in evidence. Published/CI release artifacts must use the full static bundled DuckDB path; do not bake `DUCKDB_DOWNLOAD_LIB` into `.cargo/config`, release workflows, or distributable assumptions. Verify loader/rpath implications where dynamic linkage is used. CI fast gates stay leaf-owned and slim without removing complete product/deep gates. A dependency or feature change that can alter IPC/package bytes, plans, codecs, type mapping, or performance requires golden/conformance/benchmark evidence, not merely a successful compile.

Review the lockfile as a generated supply-chain and artifact-determinism change. Determine which manifest edit or explicit update caused every material tuple change; reject unexplained broad churn, duplicate ecosystem majors, yanked/unvetted sources, git/path surprises, checksum loss, or an update detached from its owning dependency decision. Arrow, DataFusion, Parquet, ObjectStore, DuckDB/libduckdb, Tokio, compression, database, crypto, and FFI tuples are coupled policies: preserve exact compatible versions and run the active dependency-tuple/golden gates when any member moves. A lockfile-only security update still needs API, artifact-byte, type-mapping, build-linkage, and performance impact analysis appropriate to the crate. Do not hand-edit Cargo.lock, conceal a dependency downgrade, or accept downloaded-library convenience as the published release supply-chain authority.

Review automation as production infrastructure. Inspect quoting, working directories, cache keys, concurrency, timeouts, traps/cleanup, credentials, platform/architecture matrix, exit-code propagation, and whether the command actually exercises the claimed artifact. Report only concrete introduced defects with consequence and repair; secret leakage, destructive cleanup outside owned paths, silently skipped gates, wrong release linkage, unbounded cloud cost, or misleading green evidence is stop-line.

Fast CI is intentionally slim and leaf-owned; deep/static/security/product/performance gates remain explicit tiers and must not be deleted or mislabeled. Avoid N redundant full-workspace Cargo builds; use appropriate parallel jobs and shared coordinator ownership. Formatting, clippy with workspace lint walls, generated-artifact freshness, gitleaks, deny/vet, conformance, product smoke, and release checks must fail on real violations rather than blanket-ignore them. Historical gitleaks allowlists must be exact, evidence-backed fingerprints—not broad path/regex exclusions or baseline regeneration that hides new secrets.

Developer/benchmark commands may set `DUCKDB_DOWNLOAD_LIB=1`; published and CI release builds must compile the full static bundled DuckDB binary. Preserve the pinned tuple and record linkage/profile in benchmark evidence. EC2 performance scripts must create/reuse one tagged host for a tranche, verify instance/cgroup/disk/network facts, use release artifacts and recorded datasets, collect wall/user/sys/RSS/phase data, and tear the host down or prove by tag query that none remains. Never infer teardown from a missing local state file. Heavy 100 GiB/1 TiB stress does not run on the developer laptop.

Shell/Python review includes injection, word splitting, globbing, path traversal, temp-file races, `set -euo pipefail` semantics, pipeline exit status, retries/backoff, partial downloads, checksums, archive extraction, permissions, process trees, signal forwarding, and cleanup on every terminal path. Redact credentials, signed URLs, tokens, account IDs where required, and command output before storing evidence. Generated docs/schemas/snapshots must be produced by their owner tool and checked for semantic—not just textual—freshness.

Review this 10x record as durable project authority for a cold-start engineer. Check active source/decisions/specs and referenced paths rather than accepting polished prose. Report only concrete inconsistencies with consequence and repair; unratified semantics presented as decided, a false terminal status, broken graph references, stale authority that could drive wrong implementation, or evidence overstated beyond its procedure is stop-line.

Every record has valid Status/Created/Updated headers and the correct durable purpose. Accepted decisions are immutable and superseded rather than edited. Specs are regeneration-grade contracts with explicit exclusions, errors, scenarios, and acceptance. Tickets are bounded executable owners with scope/non-goals/acceptance/references/provenanced assumptions/append-only journal/blockers/evidence/review/retrospective; parent programs are not executable. A ticket is done only when each criterion maps to evidence with limits, adversarial review passes or accepted residual risk is recorded, specs/source/tests/docs agree, performance-sensitive defaults are measured or opt-in, superseded paths are removed, discoveries have owners, and references/statuses are repaired. Cancel invalid/unvaluable/parked work with rationale and reactivation trigger. Terminal records preserve history but are not current authority.

Evidence distinguishes unit, integration, conformance, product smoke, benchmark, and static-check claims. Commands, versions, host/cell, relevant output, supported conclusion, and limits are present; planned logical bytes are not physical I/O; a passing check is not global correctness. Performance numbers identify commit, profile/linkage, host, dataset, knobs, wall/user/sys/RSS, repeats/variance, roofline, and bias. Generated `docs/performance-envelope.md` is updated only through its reconciliation manifest/tool. Cloud resources, external writes, and teardown are truthfully recorded without secrets.

Records must preserve the current architecture: one built-in catalog; neutral extension seams; fixed-schema stream admission; multi-file/streaming behavior; singular CPU/memory/disk authorities; deterministic package/receipt/checkpoint calculus; current-only CDF formats; compiler lint walls; driver/session concurrency canon; shared typed catalog-task and destination-common mechanisms; typed CLI reports and Environment errors; DataFusion analysis/scheduling without identity bytes. Report only concrete introduced defects with exact consequence and a practical repair; consolidate related issues and avoid style-only noise. Stop-line findings include data or identity corruption, source/destination specificity leaking into generic architecture, secret exposure, unsafe or panic-prone boundaries, unbounded memory/disk/descriptors, cancellation/rollback/idempotency failure, broken package→receipt→checkpoint gating, and measured performance regression.

CDF has one current product path: delete superseded implementations and fixtures rather than adding legacy shims, while preserving external protocol compatibility and all present correctness fences. Plans freeze schema and semantic authority before execution; runtime observations select recorded total verdicts; identity is deterministic across jobs/replay; DataFusion may analyze/schedule but not produce identity-bearing bytes. Runtime work is byte-bounded and accounted under singular CPU/memory/disk authorities with bounded spill and terminal cleanup. Performance-sensitive defaults require comparable evidence or explicit knobs, and superseded slow paths are removed.

Validate security/redaction/egress, typed errors and actionable remediation, atomic publication and recovery, generated artifact freshness, representative product/conformance coverage, and truthful 10x ticket/evidence state.
